title: CAMP GX700 gravel bike
notes: Current exact-model page supports a CNY 9,999 add-to-cart price, JD Buy Now route, 10.2 kg small-size complete weight excluding pedals and small accessories, 700x45C stock tires, ST-RX820 controls, RD-RX822 rear derailleur, FC-RX610 36T crank, CS-M6100 10–51T cassette, aluminum wheels, T700 + T800 carbon seatpost, four colors and 7–10 working-day delivery subject to stock. The 45C tire is the stock fit rather than a stated maximum. Frame-only weight, bottom bracket and numeric geometry remain unresolved.
